{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not completed sales)
df_filtered = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any QA orders remain
qa_orders_filtered = df_filtered[df_filtered['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders after filtering refunded: {len(qa_orders_filtered)}")

# Now check the revenue column — it's string, so parse it
# First, ensure no non-numeric strings
print("Unique revenue values:", df_filtered['revenue'].unique()[:20])  # Show first 20

# Strip commas and convert to float
df_filtered['revenue_float'] = df_filtered['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any non-numeric values after cleaning
print("Any non-numeric revenue after cleaning?", df_filtered['revenue_float'].isna().sum())

# Check the conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference: email minus paid_search
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
